technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 桌面宠物和状态提示为常见形式，创新只计 DSH 的会话气泡入口，取小幅档。[Q02](#research-q02) 包内宿主事件映射、快照排序与可见性复用同一套反馈，改变多会话的展示组织，机制取实质档，短状态仍可能漏掉。最短任务可用事件投影和阵列素材设计迁到有同类会话事件的宿主，迁移仍需重新接线，取实质档。相比在多个面板重复查状态，可用一个浮层跳回现有会话，组合取实质档，未解决完整历史呈现。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 先由常驻提示定位再回原视图查结果，改变并行等待的注意力路径，流程取实质档。任务成果仍是原会话交付，未识别新的交付单位。[Q03](#research-q03) 支持的宿主可读中英文介绍，对找插件有小幅可达性增量。[Q04](#research-q04) 避免部分人工切换是有条件推断，持续资源、网络和回查成本未知，经济项按小幅设计增量。

recommendation.reason: 使用兼容 DSH Web 且接受启动心跳的用户，可以用 DSH Pet 为两个临时会话的活动做常驻提醒。相比手工切换会话，气泡能在当前页面提示活动并跳回仍存在的会话。如果气泡误指会话、持续漏掉关键状态或请求不合要求，请移除插件并改用原生会话视图。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 服务 1058–1096 与客户端 509–515 给出并行等待、状态回查与跳转的完整场景，超过偶发装饰的用途。缺重复任务频度与负担记录，保留部分成立。

advantage.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 气泡在当前视图可直接回跳，是相对原生列表的实际步骤增量。[Q02](#research-q02) 前台约两秒快照对短事件有漏显，正确识别和节时待测，得部分成立而非较充分。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 宿主 apply、事件、路由、Web 轮询与导航已追到源码。[Q04](#research-q04) 遥测和关闭分支有实际调用证据，超过局部入口支持，足以设计有限试用。固定包、宿主和效果未执行，按源码上限取档。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 临时 profile 及宿主路由释放使退出有具体路径，优于无退出办法的低档。要求接受网络行为，真实浏览器清理、遮挡及性能未实测，负担尚不足进入较充分档。

Each slot accepts one line or a pool of lines; a declared slot replaces the built-in pool for that slot only. Success and cooldown pools use the corresponding persisted success or rejection count, while noTreats cycles independently. This is how community contributions give their pet its own witty voice.\n- `frames` counts the used columns per row (defaults to the hatch-pet contract table `[6, 8, 8, 4, 5, 8, 6, 6, 6]`); `tracks` overrides per-frame durations (cycled to the row's frame count), `loop`, and `fallback` per animation (defaults: everything loops; `jumping` and `failed` hold their last frame, then fall back to `idle`).\n- `sequences` optionally maps activity scenes (`idle` / `waiting` / `thinking` / `tool` / `review` / `done` / `failed`) to at least 5 animation tracks. Selecting a skin swaps the pet's base idle target (the idle phase, unmapped phases and every fallback back to idle) onto `idleTrack`, so the resting look changes while gameplay tracks (shy/work/sleep…) stay attached to the default assets. The built-in whale derives from the DeepSeek wordmark (MIT); see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.\n## Announcement bubbles (pet.announce)\n\nHost-side sibling plugins can push one structured announcement through the `pet` cordis service (`ctx.pet.announce({ source, kind, title, ... })`); the browser half renders it as a dedicated, specially styled bubble riding the top of the session bubble stack — its own glass style with a tone accent (`ok`/`warn`/`low`), an amount pill for balance or today-spend kinds, a mini meter for plan-percent windows, and the reset instant. The payload is validated into a bounded shape (src/announce.ts): unknown fields drop, text truncates, TTL clamps to 1 s - 2 h (default 10 s; a repeating announcer declares its poll cadence so an always-mode bubble stays continuous, and the ceiling still unmounts a dead source's bubble within one missed refresh), and a malformed announcement is dropped silently. Announcements are in-memory only: each publisher holds its own slot keyed by `source`, an expired one stops rendering, and neither pet.json nor the ledger is touched. Every fresh slot renders as its own bubble, stacked above the session bubbles in the order each publisher first arrived: a repeating publisher refreshes its own bubble in place, so two publishers on different cadences never swap positions and the stack never flickers. The table is bounded (`MAX_ANNOUNCEMENTS`, 4). A lapsed publisher frees its own slot; a genuinely full table hands its oldest slot to the arriving publisher rather than refusing it, so a publisher that keeps refreshing is never the one evicted. built-in Blue-throated Bee-eater pet (9-row atlas + previews)\n`-- cordis.patch.yml # bundle patch: inserts the pet plugin row\n```\n\n### Data flow\n\n```text\nofficial session events (turn/step/chunk/tool) ----\\\n > PetService (host) <-- registry (assets + custom pets)\noptional legacy activity/status ------------------/\n | /api/pet/* JSON\nglobal React root (createRoot → document.body) <-- polling 2s -- pet-client (browser)\n |\n PetSprite floating layer (portal + rAF)\n```\n\n- **Status source**: the host projects official `turn/start`, `step/start`, `assistant/message`, `tool/call`, `tool/result`, and `turn/end` events plus live `agent/assistant-stream` chunks into waiting/thinking/tool/review/done/failed states. Optional legacy `activity/status` events remain a compatibility input.\n- **Registry**: the host normalizes every manifest into a full render definition (geometry, per-row frame counts, per-track durations) and serves it over `/api/pet/pets`; the browser half renders any entry from that definition and carries no per-pet code.\n- **Selection & naming**: `petId` lives in the plugin's own configuration — the profile entry the Host serves the Pet settings page from; per-pet names live in `pet.json` under `names`, edited through the hover-panel rename of the active pet. Legacy installs migrate their flat `name` onto the whale girl.\n- **Display**: `visible`, `size`, `right`, `bottom`, and `bubbleScale` persist in `pet.json` and are edited from the settings card. Bubble typography follows the sprite's own size (12px at the default 160px pet) and `bubbleScale` multiplies that result, bounded to 10–24px so a shrunk pet never carries unreadable text (issue #1549).\n- **Multi-session semantics**: the API and browser mount are host-global and expose no foreground-session identity. Concurrent sessions each keep their own projected state: the most recent meaningful event drives the sprite animation, while every active TOP-LEVEL session reports its stage in its own bubble (the state view's sessions list, capped at 12 most-recent). Subagent children are tracked for animation, rewards, and the single display bubble but render no bubble of their own, so N conversations never multiply into an N-plus-subagents stack. Every session's completed turns are still rewarded independently; disposing a session removes its bubble, and disposing the display session falls back to the most recent remaining one.\n- **Mount point**: `document.body` (global React root, always shown: no session / new session / mid-session — the old mount point `conversation.composer.dock` only rendered in an active session, hiding the pet in new sessions); the component uses `createPortal` internally to render the global floating layer. The root follows the plugin fiber lifecycle: fiber disposal unmounts the React root, removes the container, and stops the poll loop and settings subscription; a hot-reloaded or re-injected bundle takes over the page-global slot, so the page always holds exactly one `[data-dsh-pet-root]` (issue #785).\n- **Rendering**: CSS sprite (background-position) per-frame animation; frame durations and optional scene sequences come from the served definition. The hover panel is anchored below the pet with a pointer bridge across the gap; when the viewport leaves no room below, it flips above the pet and is lifted clear of the status bubble stack so the two never overlap.\n- **Communication**: browser ↔ host over the same-origin `/api/pet/*` JSON endpoints (state/pets/interact/set-visible/set-config/set-name/set-pet); each pet's atlas loads from `/pet//` — the plugin self-sufficiently provides its own API and assets (the same pattern as dsh-remote-web-ui's `/api/pair`).\n\n## Install\n\nInstall the family aggregate package `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` (all plugins and skins in one) or this plugin alone:\n\n```sh\n### From npm (recommended)\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-pet@latest\n\n### From the repository (development)\ngit clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git\ncd dsh-web\npnpm install && pnpm -r build\ndsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-pet\n\n```\n\nAfter installing, **restart `dsh web`** — your selected pet appears at the bottom-right of the interface.
